title: Kissed Smoky Mediterranean Oats Bake
description: A smoky and crumbly Mediterranean dish featuring rolled oats, perfect for a festive gathering, made in a stone bowl and wrapped in a ti leaf for added flavor and presentation, this dish is egg free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the rolled oats, smoked paprika, chopped kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, and chopped sun dried tomatoes.
If using feta cheese, crumble it into the bowl and mix well.
Spoon the mixture into 4 ti leaf wraps, placing them in a stone bowl.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the oats are lightly toasted and the filling is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped olives and sun dried tomatoes if desired.
